name: Soochow Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Soochow Securities Co., Ltd. engages in the securities business in China. The company offers investment banking services, such as equity and bond financing, Beijing Stock Exchange and new third board, and industry fund services; and wealth management services, including securities brokerage, investment advisory, financial products, securities and finance, institutional services, and futures IB services. It also provides asset management and investment transaction services; research services comprising macro research, upstream energy, high-end manufacturing, consumer goods, and TMT; and online services. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Suzhou, China.
